g.text: File, folder or URL to import
Path to a local file or a URL…
Import a file, a whole folder, or a URL. Supported: PDF documents, Word/Office documents, audio/video files, e-books, images, plain text files, web pages.
Imported items are searchable in your Library and can be used as context in chat.
Enter a file path or URL to start.
typing in field | esc back | enter check this path | F6 next pane | F1 help · Ctrl+P palette · Ctrl+Q quit
